beats.text: Germany's students spend 9 years in secondary school. In the USA, it is just 6.
This counts the total number of grades a student completes in secondary school.
Germany is the world's highest. 9 years of classrooms and study.
In the USA, that journey is shorter. 6 years.
Germany has 1.5 times the years of schooling you get in the USA.
The global median is 6 years. China and Japan both match that.
Slovakia matches the top at 9. India and Russia have 7. South Africa has 5.
